messages:
Samir (AE): Need deal-desk approval — Medius Health wants an 8-week private pilot (2x A100 equiv). Asking for 40% off list + waive onboarding / PS. HIPAA/BAA required. Customer target spend for pilot = ~< $25k. Estimate list = $36k. Reason: strategic healthcare reference, high convert potential. @Lina @Tom please advise.
Lina (Sales Ops): what's the expected conversion? any formal MOU or exec sponsor?
Samir (AE): conversion probability ~60% to a 12mo dedicated commit. Exec sponsor = Dr. Patel (CIO). No signed MOU yet; can get a short MOU if we pre-approve pricing.
Tom (Finance): 40% is steep on an 8-week pilot. Need margin/back-of-envelope before deal desk signs. What's gross margin at 40%?
Elena (Solutions Eng): heads-up: private deployment + BAA means infra+eng ops -> non-trivial cost. 2x A100 reserved for 8 weeks = infra ops + cloud reserve ~ $6k/week baseline (ballpark). Also PS time if we do onboarding.
Raj (Product): product side ok with short private env, but security questionnaire + SOC2 items must be answered before we hand over a node.
Lina (Sales Ops): please add a one-pager justification: strategic reference, conversion odds, exec sponsor, and any paid-for services to offset cost. Also: what exactly are we waiving on onboarding?
Samir (AE): onboarding PS fee is normally $8k. We propose waiving PS if customer signs an MOU committing to pursue conversion within 6 months. Dr. Patel ok to sign MOU contingent on price.
Tom (Finance): if we waive PS and give 40% off, contribution margin goes very low or negative. Alternative: approve 30% off + waive PS conditional on signed MOU within 3 weeks. Or 25% off if no commit. Need deal-desk approval for any >25%.
deal-desk-bot: Deal Desk request logged: DD-2026-981. Please attach justification and finance approval to escalate.
Lina (Sales Ops): I can escalate. Proposed conditional approval: up to 30% off for the pilot provided all of the following: (1) signed MOU within 3 weeks committing to a 6-month conversion option at a pre-agreed price; (2) customer completes security questionnaire and signs BAA; (3) customer covers network egress and overage charges during pilot. If any condition fails, pilot reverts to list pricing and infra charges.
Tom (Finance): approved 30% conditional (subject to revenue ops tagging this as a one-time promo and monitoring conversion). If they convert, we'll reprice to committed rate per MOU. If they don't, charge back the discount as a clawback or bill for infra delta.
Elena (Solutions Eng): I'll push the security questionnaire to Medius today, ETA 48h for answers. I will also scope minimal onboarding so we can actually waive PS fees if the MOU is signed. We'll cap reserved nodes to 2x A100 and monitor usage; any burst above cap billed back.
Samir (AE): I'll send the MOU draft to Dr. Patel today and include the conditional 30% pilot pricing + conversion clause. Thanks — will update thread when MOU sent :thumbsup:
Lina (Sales Ops): please attach the MOU + security answers here once available. I'll move DD-2026-981 to review and add final sign-off if docs meet conditions.
Samir (AE): noted. Quick pricing snapshot for reference:
```
List pilot cost (8w): $36,000
40% off -> $21,600
30% off -> $25,200  (conditional approval requested)
Waived PS normally +$8,000
Estimated infra baseline cost (ours): ~$6k/week -> ~$48k total (we need to reconcile/cap)
```
Lina (Sales Ops): good to have numbers. FYI finance wants the MOU to include a minimum conversion ARR clause or a repayment clause if they walk.
Tom (Finance): exactly. I'll draft the minimum financial terms for the MOU and send to @Samir today.
Samir (AE): thanks everyone — I'll coordinate MOU + security answers. Will tag when docs uploaded.
Elena (Solutions Eng): tagging operations: we'll hold nodes until MOU signed. If timeline slips, we'll propose a reduced pilot or shift to non-dedicated environment.
Samir (AE): understood. I'll keep timeline tight. Appreciate the quick turn on this.
